methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified against manufacturer pages (GE Appliances, Panasonic shop, Whirlpool, Breville) and major retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Lowe's, Best Buy, Home Depot, Abt) plus appliances.techreviewer.com. All 11 models are real and verifiable; no products were removed. The COSORI microwave was correctly excluded by the writer (COSORI markets air fryers/toaster ovens, no microwave SKU exists). Corrections applied: (1) Toshiba EM131A5C-BS rated output is 1000W, not 1100W — manufacturer Amazon/Walmart/Lowe's listings and rtings all state 1000W; techreviewer's 1100W appears to be an input/output mix-up. (2) Breville Combi Wave BMO870BSS DOES have a glass turntable (12.4 in, replacement part SP0027406; manual states the turntable must be installed for operation) — the draft's turntable:false / 'flat interior with wire racks' was a fabrication (that describes Breville's Smart Oven Air Fryer, not the Combi Wave microwave). (3) Toshiba ML-EM45PIT sensor-menu count is reported as both 5 and 6 across sources, so preset_count set to null rather than guess. (4) Galanz GLCMKZ11BKR10 list price updated to Best Buy's $139.99 (DealNews has shown ~$120-134 on deal). The 'GLCMKZ11S' and 'ML-EM45P(SS)' draft SKUs do not exist; documented representatives BKR10 (black) and ML-EM45PIT(SS) (stainless inverter) are used. wattage_w = rated output power. booleans true when confirmed, false when denied, null when unconfirmed. Prices are typical current US retail or published MSRP. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Toshiba EM131A5C-BS Countertop Microwave
products.provenance: Capacity 1.2 cu ft, 12 auto menus, smart humidity sensor, 12.4-in removable turntable, 20.5-in width confirmed across Amazon (manufacturer listing), Walmart, Lowe's, and rtings.com. CORRECTED wattage 1100->1000: the rated output power is 1000W per the Amazon/Walmart/Lowe's titles and rtings review; the draft's 1100W (from techreviewer) conflates input/output. No inverter. 2017 release. Price ~$129-149 across retailers; Lowe's list $139.99 used.

products.name: Panasonic NN-SN686S Inverter Countertop Microwave
products.provenance: Verified on Panasonic official shop: 1.2 cu ft, 1200W, 13.4-in turntable, Genius Sensor (sensor cooking), Inverter Technology, 14 auto-cook settings, price $294.95. Width 20.69 in (20 11/16). Official model is NN-SN686SR; NN-SN686S Amazon listing is the same product. ~2016 first availability. All draft values confirmed.

products.name: GE JES1095SMSS 0.9 Cu. Ft. Countertop Microwave
products.provenance: GE Appliances page: 0.9 cu ft, MSRP $129, dimensions 11.5H x 19W x 14.5D, explicitly 'no longer being manufactured.' 900W (IEC-705) per Lowe's/Amazon. Turntable, auto/time defrost confirmed; no discrete preset count or sensor cooking -> preset_count null, sensor_cooking false. No inverter. Release year not found -> null.

products.name: Breville Combi Wave 3-in-1 (BMO870BSS)
products.provenance: Breville official page: $499.95, 19 smart presets, Power Smoothing Inverter, Smart Cook/Reheat/Defrost sensor functions. Capacity 1.1 cu ft (32L), 1200W microwave, 20.4-in width per Abt/toptenreviews. CORRECTED turntable false->true: the Combi Wave has a 12.4-in glass turntable (replacement part SP0027406; manual requires turntable installed for operation) per Best Buy, Abt, and the user manual. The draft's 'flat interior with wire racks' wrongly described Breville's Smart Oven Air Fryer, not this microwave. ~March 2020 release.

products.name: Toshiba ML-EM45PIT(SS) Inverter Countertop Microwave
products.provenance: The requested 'ML-EM45P(SS)' SKU does not exist; the stainless inverter variant ML-EM45PIT(SS) is used. Confirmed on Amazon/Lowe's/Target: 1.6 cu ft, 1250W, Origin Inverter Technology, Smart Sensor, 13.6-in removable turntable, 21.8-in width. CORRECTED preset_count 6->null: sensor-menu count is reported as both 5 (Lowe's/Origin) and 6 (Amazon title) across sources, so nulled rather than guessed. Price ~$179-214 in 2025-2026; $199.99 used. ~2020 release (ASIN B085G2T7NS).
